title: The 5 Best Pet Cameras for Treat Dispensing
h1: The 5 Best Pet Cameras for Treat Dispensing
metaDescription: Our 5 picks for pet cameras for treat dispensing, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at pet cameras for treat dispensing using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Petcube Bites 2
products.blurb: Key specs: 1080p HD video with 160° full-room view, Built-in treat dispenser with adjustable toss distance, 4-microphone array with 2-way audio.
strengths: The only camera in this list with a built-in treat dispenser, a genuine differentiator from standard pet cameras
Adjustable toss distance lets you tune how far treats land relative to the camera's position
Alexa built-in enables hands-free treat dispensing through voice commands
4-microphone array reliably picks up barking that might prompt a treat toss to redirect attention
limitations: Treat hopper needs manual refilling every few days with regular use
Mechanism requires specific small, dry, uniform treats to avoid jamming
features: Built-in treat dispenser with adjustable toss distance

products.name: Ring Indoor Cam (2nd Gen)
products.blurb: Key specs: 1080p HD video with color night vision, 115° horizontal field of view, Two-way talk.
strengths: No dispenser to jam or refill, meaningfully lower maintenance than a treat-tossing camera
Costs well under half the price of the Petcube Bites 2
Two-way talk still provides a form of remote interaction without needing a treat mechanism
limitations: No treat dispensing at all, a real limitation for owners specifically wanting this feature
115° field of view is narrower than pan/tilt alternatives
Ring Protect subscription needed to review saved clips
features: 1080p HD video with color night vision

products.name: Wyze Cam Pan v3
products.blurb: Key specs: 360° pan / 180° tilt coverage, 1080p color night vision, 2-way audio.
strengths: Full pan/tilt coverage that a fixed-position dispenser camera cannot match
Lowest price of any camera in this list
Motion tracking follows a pet even without a treat incentive to hold their attention
No mechanical hopper to jam or clean
limitations: Two-way audio is thinner than the Petcube's 4-microphone setup
Cloud storage for longer clips needs an optional subscription
features: No subscription required for live view

products.name: Furbo 360° Dog Camera
limitations: Advanced alerts need a paid plan
Treat size must fit the dispenser

products.name: Petcube Cam 360 with Bites 2 Lite
limitations: Two devices to place and power

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
